intro: Orendil's Cure is an urgent delivery errand tasked to Alliance travelers by the herbalist Orendil Broadleaf. After concocting a remedy from rare flora, Orendil sends the courier racing down the woodland roads to Astranaar to save a dying night elf child.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I have created a cure that I believe will help the afflicted child. Take it to Astranaar and give it to the child's parent, Pelturas Whitemoon.
To reach Astranaar, follow the road south, then east.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak. My child, Relara, is deathly ill!

clips.title: Completion
paras: His skill with herbs and healing is great. This cure gives me hope, when before I had little...
